name: Jalan Besar
summary: DTL-adjacent food and creative belt between Lavender and Farrer Park — late kitchens, older walk-ups, and condo inserts with nightlife spillover as the tax.
body: Jalan Besar is the shortlist when late-kitchen energy and city-fringe rents matter more than mall living. Housing mixes older shophouse walk-ups, boutique condos, and estate edges toward Lavender / Bendemeer; weekend nightlife and food crowds are the tax. Expats land here for CBD-adjacent hops, independent F&B, and a slightly calmer feel than Bugis retail crush. Compare with Little India for deeper cultural-belt density, Rochor for DTL interchange convenience, and Lavender when you want EWL optionality with similar older-stock texture.
bestFor: car-light couples who want food density without Orchard rents
households okay with late-kitchen and weekend energy
condo renters who will book MA lift slots for moves
people testing city-fringe before River Valley premiums
watchOuts: Weekend nightlife and food crowd spikes
Block-level variance in MCST move-in ops
housingMix: Older walk-ups and shophouse edges with boutique condo inserts.
commuteNotes: Walk or short bus/MRT hop via Lavender (EWL/DTL), Farrer Park (NEL), or Bendemeer; test a Friday 20:30 street-level walk before you assume quiet nights.
